note: Minted 2026-08-16 (issue #407) as the umbrella command+skill fanning out all five authorkit audit instruments plus the harness cross-plugin axes into one verdict-first roll-up. Distinct from estate-audit (that skill only NAMES which single instrument fits — no procedure of its own) and from overhaul-execute (that skill MUTATES through gated waves; this one only ever reports).

cases.prompt: Audit this whole repo across every instrument you have and give me one verdict.
Run the full audit battery over this estate — naming, bloat, attention, doctrine, the works.
Give me a single roll-up of naming, bloat, attention, and routing health for this plugin set.
How healthy is this repo across every audit axis we have installed?
I want a red/yellow/green verdict per estate per audit instrument, in one report.
Audit this plugin for naming conformance.
cases.comment: owner: naming-audit — one instrument, not the full battery

cases.prompt: Audit this skill for busy-work and ceremony.
Which of authorkit's audit instruments should I use to check for busy-work versus naming conformance?
cases.comment: owner: estate-audit — chooses ONE instrument, no battery run

cases.prompt: Drive the approved overhaul plan through its execution waves.
cases.comment: owner: overhaul-execute — mutates through gated waves; this skill never mutates

cases.prompt: Sweep the ops queue and give me a prioritized action list.
cases.comment: owner: harness sweep-chores — live ops/work-state, not authorkit's static audit instruments

cases.prompt: What's the current state of this repo — branches, open PRs, drift since last check?
cases.comment: owner: harness check-state — point-in-time work-state, not the audit battery

cases.prompt: Sweep the repo for every match of this caller-supplied regex and give me the dataset.
cases.comment: owner: pattern-audit — one instrument, and only when a concrete pattern is supplied
